question: When passing stationary vehicles, keep a watch on ___________ who may come out suddenly from the front of the stationary vehicle. While overtaking, it should be done on the __________ side. Always keep a good _________________ between your vehicle and others.
solution:
The correct answer is __pedestrians; right; distance.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• While passing stationary vehicles, it is important to keep an eye on pedestrians__, as they may come out suddenly from the front of the stationary vehicle.
 
• When overtaking, it should always be done on the __right side__ of the vehicle.
 
• Maintaining a __safe distance__ between your vehicle and others ensures better safety and reduces risks of accidents.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Safety Measures:**

 
 
• Always stay alert and avoid distractions while driving near stationary vehicles or pedestrians.
 
• Use indicators and check mirrors before overtaking to ensure safe maneuvering.
 
 
 
• **Road Awareness:**
 
 
• Be cautious of cyclists or motorcyclists while passing stationary vehicles.
 
• Always adhere to traffic rules and maintain lane discipline.
